name: elevenlabs
summary: Completed the ElevenLabs quickstart end-to-end. Installed the elevenlabs and python-dotenv packages, created the example script, and successfully generated a valid MP3 audio file from text using the ElevenLabs Text-to-Speech API. The output file (/home/daytona/output.mp3) is 46,019 bytes, confirmed by `file` and `ffmpeg` as a proper MPEG ADTS layer III audio file at 44.1 kHz, 128 kbps, mono, ~2.85 seconds duration.
deviations: The quickstart's final step calls `play(audio)` to play audio through speakers. Since the sandbox is headless with no audio output, I replaced `play(audio)` with code that saves the audio stream to a file (`/home/daytona/output.mp3`). This is the only deviation — the core API request, authentication, and text-to-speech generation follow the quickstart exactly.
